text:
Evan: follow-up from RFC - we need a concrete affinity selector decision for routing fp8/int8/fp32. quick vote?
Priya: constraints: avoid cache key explosion, deterministic canaries, clear billing.
Kunal: lean towards: client hint header (X-Affinity: quality|balanced|cost) + resolved affinity_id from mapping service. affinity_id used in cache key and billing, hint not included.
Zara: runtime must pin affinity_id at request start and include profile_stamp in cache key (model_v + profile_stamp). mapping changes affect future requests only.
Evan: agreement? thumbs?
Priya: thumbs. add re-eval TTL of 5m for mapping per-tenant to avoid oscillation.
Kunal: fallback chain: per-model explicit lists. runtime steps down on quant-fail or OOM and emits audit event. examples in doc.
Zara: telemetry: per-affinity cohorts with kl_mean, nll_delta, error_rate on 10m windows. alert thresholds: KL>0.1 warn, >0.18 critical; error_rate_delta>0.03 critical.
Evan: add hourly shadow-eval (0.1% sampling) to compare candidate vs fp32 baseline.
Priya: ops needs CLI and one-click revert in console. also billing tag affin_billing to surface. tenant caps should auto-downgrade when hit.
infra-bot: noted. will create incident ticket if fallback_rate > 1% for 5m.
Evan: action items: Kunal spec for mapping API + cache-stamping (PR by Wed); Priya ops runbook + CLI (doc by Fri); Zara telemetry dashboards + thresholds (dashboard by Thu).
Priya: will draft runbook and post in #eng-oncall. closing thread.
